Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Are you a senior Front-End Developer passionate about Design Systems, UI craft, and bridging the gap between design and engineering at enterprise scale?
 If you enjoy building accessible component libraries with React and TypeScript, working with design tokens, and empowering hundreds of designers and thousands of developers, this role is for you.
 Our philosophy is “First who, then what.” 
 📍 This role is hybrid (3 days/week on-site in Bucharest).
 🚀 First who? 
8+ years of front-end development experience, including 2–3 years working within a dedicated Design System team.
Strong expertise in React, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML, and modern CSS (pre/post-processors are a plus).
Proven experience building and maintaining scalable UI component libraries and translating Figma designs into production code (Penpot is a plus).
Solid hands-on experience implementing WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and working with design tokens for multi-brand theming.
Strong UI culture and eye for visual detail, paired with the ability to structure, rationalize, and document code for wide adoption.
Collaborative mindset with experience facilitating workshops and working closely with designers and multidisciplinary contributors.
Fluent in English (minimum C1 level); professional proficiency in French is a plus.
 🚀 Then what? 
You’ll help drive the evolution and transformation of a core enterprise digital Design System adopted by 300+ designers and 2,000+ developers.
You’ll operate within a lean central product team (in Agile-Kanban) while collaborating with a broader guild of 30+ contributors across the organization.
You’ll act as a technical reference for UI quality, accessibility, and scalable component architecture across web and desktop technologies.
 📌 Your mission 
Design, develop, evolve, and maintain reusable, high-quality UI components in React and TypeScript
Implement and advance design token architectures to support theming and a single source of truth between design and code
Ensure all components and patterns meet at least WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility and visual consistency standards
Translate complex Figma libraries, variants, and guidelines into clean, well-documented implementation packages
Collaborate with designers, stakeholders, and the contributor guild to align on patterns and drive system adoption
Structure, rationalize, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for engineering teams across the organization
 ⚙️ Your toolbox 
 Technical Skills
React & TypeScript / JavaScript
HTML5 & Modern CSS (pre/post-processors - plus)
Design Systems & Component Library Architecture
Design Tokens & Multi-Theme Systems
Accessibility Standards (WCAG 2.1 AA minimum)
Figma (design-to-code workflows; Penpot - plus)
Collaborative IDE environments & Agile / Kanban workflows
UX Design Methodologies (user research, usability testing) - plus
 General Skills
Sharp eye for UI detail, visual consistency, and code quality
Systemic, structured approach to documentation and scalability
Inspiring, flexible technical leadership and community-building mindset
Autonomous, curious, and comfortable navigating evolving product contexts
Strong communication across multidisciplinary design and engineering teams
English C1 minimum (mandatory); French - plus
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the First who and see yourself thriving in the Then what? 
 👉 Apply now and let’s talk.
